run_pump_code_generation: run pump.py on a .pump source file to generate repetitive C++ boilerplate code
convert_pump_source: convert pump meta programming source text into expanded output code using ConvertFromPumpSource
parse_pump_ast: parse pump source text into an abstract syntax tree using ParseToAST
tokenize_pump_code: tokenize pump source text into tokens using the Tokenize generator function
beautify_generated_code: beautify generated code by wrapping long lines to 80 characters using BeautifyCode
